exposure: Fetoscopic endoscopic occlusion (FETO) with a novel endotracheal balloon (FETO-balloon)
Severe or extremely severe left, right, or bilateral fetal CDH
cohort: 30 pregnant women (18-45 years old) with singleton pregnancies and a confirmed diagnosis of severe or extremely severe fetal CDH
finding: The study aims to evaluate the effectiveness of a novel endotracheal balloon (FETO-balloon) for fetoscopic endoscopic occlusion (FETO) in improving survival and morbidity rates in newborns with severe CDH.
gest_age: 24-34 weeks for RDS prevention; 37-38 weeks for delivery
